m_questTitle: The Thrill is in the Chase

m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Greetings, Sheriff. What can this unit buttle for you today?
Error! Attacking Cretan Bull violates the First Law of Aerobotics. This action is impossible. Searching Memory Core for verification...
Error! All data from time of Cretan Bull attack not found! Memories erased! Error! Error!
Error! System scans indicate anti-attack safeguards were removed. Error! User identity from time of removal erased!
Negative! Need time to process, to recover deleted data from cache. Must find out who altered systems.
Will engage in defensive measures if processing is interrupted.
System Reconstruction at 50%. Core systems... shutting... down.
The Cretan Bull said his attacker bristled his brain with a vengeful brush? Of course! I shoulda figured it out earlier.
Only one of the three suspects carries a brush around: the cleaning robot, Ebenezer.
On top of that, Max and Eleanor's alibis checked out. But that dang old Aerobot never had one. I say it's time we confront the attacker.
The jig's up, Ebenezer. We know you attacked the Cretan Bull and you're going down for it.
After him, Wizard, don't let him get away!
Easy now, Ebenezer, ain't nobody going to hurt you.
Have it your way. Get him, Wizard.
You done good, Wizard. I'll haul this pile of scrap over to the Evidence Lock-Up. Come talk to me back in town when you can.
Well done, Wizard. We caught the varmint before he did any lasting harm. And, who knows, maybe the Cretan Bull will stand down now.
But Ebenezer is the only one that didn't have an alibi? Well, that's getting the old gray cells a-firin'.
Still, can't be sure until I verify the other two alibis. While I do that, you should talk to the Cretan Bull himself. He's in a cave on the Plains.
He's probably gotten a bit paranoid since the attack, though. So you may have a fight on your hands. Watch yourself.
You talk to the Cretan Bull out on the Southwest Aero Plains. I'll look into Max and Eleanor's alibis.
